lastCompletedStory.title: Surface the implement-blocked marker in the orchestrator boot-read

openQuestions: Neither .gitignore nor templates/.gitignore has an entry for .claude/.cam-implement-blocked.json (US-005 wrote the marker module but did not add the gitignore entry, mirroring the same gap already documented for .cam-ship-stalled.json in patterns.md line ~438). Out of scope for US-006 (templates-doc-only story); a future story could add all three missing marker entries in one pass.
nextStoryContext: US-006 added boot-read item #10 (.claude/.cam-implement-blocked.json: issueId/story/reason fields) to templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md's numbered marker list (after the plan-preflight entry, ~137-140) plus a matching opening-blocker snippet (after the plan-preflight snippet, ~180-187: '⚠ implement blocked: issue #<issueId> story <story or "none"> — <reason>'), mirroring the ship-stalled/plan-escalated/plan-preflight precedent exactly (read-only surfacing; marker only removed by the next re-armed implement dispatch for that issue, per US-005's clearImplementBlockedMarkerForCurrentIssue). Ran bun run embed-vendor + embed-vendor:check in the same commit (byte-parity gate on src/vendor/_generated.ts). This story was templates-only as anticipated by US-005's handoff notes; no src/ or test/ changes were needed since US-005 already did all the write/consume wiring. US-007 (priority 7, requires US-003 only, independent of US-005/US-006) remains the other open story in this PRD -- check prd.json for any remaining passes:false stories before assuming PRD completion.
